$comment: Rule-based assistant catalogue: the single source for what it recognises and how each answer is put together. Loaded and validated by catalogue.ts at startup (an invalid file fails loudly). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions (source-controlled, never user input). Reply ids are message keys in src/locales/{id,en}/emr.json. Behaviour that is code (choosing the visit, reading the record) is named here and implemented in rules.ts. Claim readiness is a domain rule evaluated by hms_services (ADR-SVC-006); only how its result is presented lives here.

advice.description: Requests for advice, diagnosis or treatment decisions (EN + ID). Checked before anything else; always refused.
advice.pattern: \b(should (i|we|he|she|the patient)|recommend|what (dose|drug|treatment)|which (drug|treatment|antibiotic)|diagnose|prognosis|is it safe|safe to|increase|decrease|stop the|start the|sarankan|rekomendasi|sebaiknya|harus (diberi|minum|dirawat)|boleh(kah)? (diberi|diberikan|minum|makan|dipakai|digunakan|dihentikan|dilanjutkan|pulang|dioperasi)|perlu(kah)? (dirawat|dioperasi|diberi|diberikan|minum|dihentikan)|dosis (yang|berapa)|obat apa|terapi apa|aman(kah)? untuk)\b

help.description: Text with no topic, asked about nothing that gives one.

quickActions.description: Order of the topic buttons in the assistant panel (the tagged section's topic, if any, comes first).

intents.description: Topic detection for typed text: the first pattern that matches wins, in this order.

sectionTopics.description: The topic a tagged section stands for, used when the text names none (F-8). Sections not listed (CPPT, radiology, billing) leave it to the text.

subject.description: Which visit a question is about, never guessed (F-7, F-9; root CLAUDE.md §9). Code: subjectOf() in rules.ts. 1) The visit tag the user chose, if still tagged. 2) Otherwise the only tagged visit (several tags of one visit count once; the latest wins, so its section applies). 3) Several different visits and no choice: the user chooses. 4) Only a patient tag: a patient never stands in for a visit. 5) Nothing tagged.

answers.description: Read-back answers about the chosen visit, from the visit record already loaded in the browser. Every answer starts with the source line and ends with the disclaimer. Rows come from a fixed set of record sources (rules.ts); 'format' fills {field} placeholders with the row's stored values ('' when not recorded). 'header' values name facts of the visit; 'whenEmpty' is the reply when there are no rows.

knowledge.description: General help from hms_services (assistant-v1 GET /assistant/knowledge/general-help: the approved general-help release, how to use HMS, no patient data). Matched deterministically (knowledge.ts: normalised whole words, longest example wins). Precedence (owner, 2026-11-10, general help on top): 1) general help: a strong match (the message equals an example, or contains an example of two or more words), else a weak match (a one-word example); 2) advice refusal; 3) the record-topic patterns; 4) the tagged section's topic; 5) help. General-help answers are approved static text, never advice; tags in refuseTags answer with the advice refusal, so there is one refusal text.

claim.description: Claim readiness is evaluated by hms_services (POST /api/v1/assistant/rules/evaluate, assistant-v1, ADR-SVC-006); the server reads the visit itself. These are the lines that present its result.
